prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, mid 20s goddess, super glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size; below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sleek slicked-back natural black hair — wearing a skin-tight full-body suit of densely patterned soft-ivory floral lace with the flowers closely overlapping and only a fine sheer net showing between them with long sleeves and long legs down to her ankles and a front zipper pulled down to her belly button, the material evenly tinted and softly diffusing so her own skin tone glows through it as a gentle blur across her whole body, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, hands and everywhere the sheer material veils her body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and slightly darker skin over her elbows. The garments cling to every curve and show real material behaviour: dense lace flowers and vines packed close across the fine net, the pattern stretching a little wider over her curves with scalloped edges lying flat at her wrists and ankles, her skin tone running unbroken beneath it. Pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground — most extreme super glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of silver leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in soft white lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.

Background: a grand museum hall with a pale stone floor, tall columns, a wide staircase of standard steps and plain banners without any text, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
